svg.title: ACORN geospatial Research Activity preview
svg.desc: A dark desktop and light mobile preview of the ACORN geospatial route. It shows a token-free Cesium-style globe with bundled Natural Earth II imagery, local ROR-backed organization markers, synchronized accessible organization table, selected organization details, unresolved summaries, dataset provenance, and a narrow-screen list-first fallback.
svg.metadata: Preview imagery: CesiumJS 1.118.0 Assets/Textures/NaturalEarthII/0/0/0.jpg, retrieved from cdnjs on 2026-11-10 and embedded as a data URI for offline rendering.

g.text: Locations referenced by ROR identifiers in loaded Research Activity Data.
Accessible alternative to the globe · 3 rows

svg.text: Dioxus-owned state and accessible table · route-local Resium island · local ROR index · no ion token, remote imagery, geocoding, or runtime registry calls
